_comment: Each sheet holds six guns; the slicer works out the grid itself (rows by vertical position, each row left to right, top row first). 'ids' is the gun id of each cell in that order; 'flip' lists guns painted nozzle-left, mirrored before saving; 'nozzle' optionally overrides a gun's nozzle point ({id: [x, y]} in the 384x256 picture). NOTE: the owner's files are named the other way round from the order they were first described: sheet-1-guns.jpg holds the bubble / slime / rainbow / shark / dragon / galaxy guns. Keep in step with GUN_LADDER in src/entities/gun/gun.data.ts.
